description:
What Impact You'll Have 

 Northstrat, a GRVTY company, is seeking a Full Stack Developer to join a growing program made up of multiple agile development teams. You'll take part in every Agile ceremony (stand-up, iteration planning, demos and retros). You'll write the automated end-to-end tests that prove the complex sytem of systems works as a whole: contract tests for each service interface and browser tests for full user workflows. You'll also help build a modern integration dashboard that shows the health of every interface and test run. You'll solve unique and complex problems with current technologies, building secure, scalable features that deploy through a fully automated DevSecOps pipeline.

 Technologies you will use include: 

 
 Amazon Web Services (AWS)

 Java and the Spring Framework

 Front-end frameworks such as Angular and Bootstrap

 Automated testing tools such as JUnit, Mockito, Jest, Pact and Playwright

 Databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL and Redis

 Git, GitLab or Bitbucket for source control

 Jira and Confluence for issue tracking

 DevSecOps pipeline tools such as Jenkins, SonarQube and Fortify

 
 What You'll Be Owning 

 
 Build and maintain front-end and back-end features in Angular and Java/Spring, following the team's coding standards and architecture

 Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests that keep coverage high and the pipeline green

 Design and query relational data models in PostgreSQL or MySQL

 Investigate, reproduce and fix defects found in test and production

 Write consumer-driven contract tests in Pact and end-to-end browser tests in Playwright that run on every merge

 Take part in code reviews, giving and applying feedback

 
 What You Must Have 

 
 Clearance: active TS/SCI with CI poly, or TS/SCI and willing to take a CI poly

 Experience: 3+ years of professional software development with a Bachelor's degree in a STEM field; 1+ year with a Master's; or 7+ years in place of a degree

 Hands-on experience building web applications in Java (Spring or Spring Boot preferred) and Angular

 Experience writing and consuming RESTful APIs

 Working knowledge of SQL and at least one relational database

 Experience with Git and automated testing in a CI/CD pipeline, including integration or end-to-end tests

 Available to work in person full time

 
 What Would Be Nice to Have 

 
 Experience deploying to AWS

 Container experience with Docker and Kubernetes

 Experience with Redis or another in-memory store

 Experience with Agile and DevOps practices on a government program

 Current Security+ certification, or willingness to obtain one

We’re proud to offer a work environment that empowers our team to achieve a strong work-life balance. GRVTY provides competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for professional growth.
Our benefits package is designed to support the well-being of our employees and their families, and includes coverage in areas such as healthcare, financial wellness, retirement planning, family assistance, continued education, and paid time off.

 The toughest national security challenges demand vision and ingenuity, not just resources. We deliver mission and technical expertise to outpace our adversaries. We’re purpose-built to tackle the most entrenched, systemic national security issues around the world.
